agent_finish.source: Finish a child task with a structured result accounting for its contract, evidence and gaps. summary is shorthand for tasks without required outputs and is ignored when result is provided (result.answer is the canonical summary). Active descendants must finish first.
agent_finish.text: 以结构化结果结束子任务，覆盖契约、证据和缺口。summary 仅用于无必需产物的任务；提供 result 时忽略 summary，以 result.answer 为准。活动后代必须先结束。

analysis_verify.source: Verifier only: record an independent general-analysis verdict with expected and observed results, scope, counterexamples and verifier-owned evidence. Does not promote security impact. Records are immutable and appear in shared notes.
analysis_verify.text: 仅 verifier：记录独立通用分析判定，包含期望/观察、范围、反例及验证者自己的证据。不提升安全影响；记录不可变并出现在共享笔记中。

angr_solve.source: Bounded symbolic input reconstruction for stdin validation paths. Supply module-relative success/failure addresses and expected input length. Returns a background job with candidate input and exploration statistics. Prefer direct inversion for simple reversible transforms; slice or use explicit constraints for large state spaces. Always replay candidate bytes on the real target.
angr_solve.text: 对 stdin 校验路径进行有界符号输入还原。提供模块相对成功/失败地址与输入长度，返回候选输入和探索统计的后台 job。简单可逆变换优先直接求逆，大状态空间使用切片或明确约束；必须在真实目标重放候选字节。

artifact_stage.source: Stage a hash-verified same-run evidence artifact into your assigned environment using bounded resumable transfer; returns the worker file and original evidence ID.
artifact_stage.text: 通过有界可恢复传输，将同一 run 中通过哈希校验的证据制品传入分配的环境，返回 worker 文件和原始证据 ID。

binary_inspect.source: Inspect the exact run target, architecture, sections, imports, symbols and mitigations.
binary_inspect.text: 检查本 run 的精确目标、架构、节、导入、符号和缓解机制。

binary_strings.source: Search printable strings with file-offset address references and pagination.
binary_strings.text: 分页搜索可打印字符串，附文件偏移地址引用。

context_read.source: Read a bounded character range of an exact same-run shared document as JSON, including amendments. Use kind and id from context_search; follow content.next_offset until the required content is complete.
context_read.text: 按字符范围读取同 run 的确切共享文档 JSON，含 amendments。kind/id 来自 context_search；沿 content.next_offset 读取所需完整内容。

context_search.source: Search same-run shared notes, todos and optional threat models by text, kind, author scope or agent_id. Returns bounded previews and next_offset; use context_read for exact content including amendments.
context_search.text: 按文本、kind、作者 scope 或 agent_id 搜索同 run 的笔记、待办和可选威胁模型。返回有界预览和 next_offset；用 context_read 读取完整正文及 amendments。

coverage_list.text: 列出本次分析的全部覆盖记录。

coverage_record.source: Record inspected scope, outcome and supporting evidence. needs_follow_up blocks root completion.
coverage_record.text: 记录检查范围、结果及支持证据。needs_follow_up 阻止 root 完成。

coverage_update.source: Update a coverage record's outcome, notes and evidence.
coverage_update.text: 更新覆盖记录的结果、笔记和证据。

crash_replay.source: Start a persistent clean-directory crash reproduction job.
crash_replay.text: 在干净目录启动持久化崩溃复现 job。

crash_snapshot.source: Capture registers, PC/SP, fault address, instructions, stack and module identities from an owned stopped debugger; alternatively inspect an in-run core file. Strong signatures require observed module hashes. Unknown identity remains unresolved.
crash_snapshot.text: 从自己拥有且已停止的调试会话获取寄存器、PC/SP、故障地址、指令、栈和模块身份，或检查同 run 的 core。强签名要求实际模块哈希；未知身份保持未解决。

cyclic_offset.source: Find a unique offset in an in-run cyclic pattern. Requires the original alphabet/n and exactly n observed bytes in memory order. Rejects mismatched generation parameters; never guesses endianness or truncates a register implicitly.
cyclic_offset.text: 在同 run 的 cyclic pattern 中找唯一偏移。必须提供原始 alphabet/n 及内存顺序恰好 n 字节；拒绝不一致生成参数，不猜字节序或隐式截断寄存器。

debug_close.source: Close your debugger session, or clean up an in-run session whose owner is terminal.
debug_close.text: 关闭自己的调试会话，或清理同 run 中 owner 已终止的会话。

debug_command.source: Execute exactly one GDB/MI command in your owned session; stable request IDs prevent blind replay.
debug_command.text: 在所属会话执行恰好一条 GDB/MI 命令；稳定请求 ID 防止盲目重放。

debug_start.source: Start an owned GDB/MI session on the staged target.
debug_start.text: 对暂存目标启动自己拥有的 GDB/MI 会话。

differential_test.source: Compare the staged target and reference on bounded stdin vectors in an isolated background job. Preserve raw outputs, hashes and mismatches as artifacts. Timeout or truncated output is inconclusive, never a match.
differential_test.text: 在隔离后台 job 中，以有界 stdin 向量比较暂存目标/参考实现。原始输出、哈希、差异保留产物；超时/截断是 inconclusive，不是匹配。

emulate_run.source: Bounded Unicorn emulation of the staged target from a start address: maps the ELF segments plus a stack, executes up to count instructions or until the PC reaches the until address (whichever first), and returns registers plus requested memory dumps (data_base64). The target never runs natively — this is a pure simulation for VM-style or hand-crafted code (interpreter loops, x87/FPU blocks) without hand-building Unicorn harnesses. Use init_regs for register preconditions and memory to inject bytes. The watchdog timeout bounds runaway loops; unsupported instructions report the failing address in error.
emulate_run.text: 从起始地址用 Unicorn 有界模拟暂存目标：映射 ELF 段和栈，运行到 count 条指令或 PC 到 until 地址，返回寄存器及所需内存 data_base64。目标不原生执行；可用于 VM/手工代码（解释器循环、x87/FPU）而无需自写 Unicorn harness。init_regs 设置前提寄存器，memory 注入字节；watchdog 限制失控循环，未知指令错误包含地址。

environment_doctor.source: Probe a registered environment's real platform and tools; children may probe only their assigned environment.
environment_doctor.text: 探测已登记环境的实际平台和工具；子任务只能探测分配给自己的环境。

environment_list.source: List registered analysis environments without connecting; configuration is not proof of readiness.
environment_list.text: 列出已登记的分析环境，不建立连接；配置存在不代表环境已就绪。

evidence_read.source: Read a bounded byte range from an integrity-checked evidence artifact. Non-UTF8 is base64.
evidence_read.text: 读取完整性已核对证据的有界字节范围；非 UTF-8 使用 base64。

exec_command.source: Run ONE bounded shell command synchronously in the worker and return its stdout/stderr/exit code in the result. The command runs in a fresh temporary directory: pass target=<staged path from stage_target> and the resolved file is available at $TARGET in the environment ("printf '<payload>' | $TARGET"). Prefer this for quick inspection and stdin-driven PoCs; long-running work must go to job_start with output redirected to a log file instead of blocking here. Worker paths (files/...) resolve only as direct argv entries, never inside shell strings; use $WUKONG_STATE_DIR for the state root.
exec_command.text: 在 worker 同步执行一条有界 shell 命令，返回 stdout/stderr/退出码。每次使用新临时目录；target 接收 stage_target 路径，并通过 $TARGET 暴露解析后文件（例如 "printf '<payload>' | $TARGET"）。适合快速检查和 stdin PoC；长任务用 job_start 并重定向日志。files/... 只在直接 argv 项解析，不在 shell 字符串中解析；状态根使用 $WUKONG_STATE_DIR。

file_get.source: Retrieve a declared in-run worker file and persist original bytes as evidence.
file_get.text: 取回同 run 已声明的 worker 文件，并将原始字节保存为证据。

file_put.source: Create an immutable worker file from base64 bytes (data_base64), UTF-8 text (text — preferred for scripts: no base64 encoding needed) or an existing evidence artifact. evidence_id must be the CONTENT evidence id — the record whose bytes you actually want (a tool result's content_evidence_id), NOT the tool-result envelope id: passing the envelope id writes the envelope JSON, not the bytes. Use executable=true when the file will be executed as a program.
file_put.text: 从 data_base64、UTF-8 text（脚本优先，无需 base64）或已有证据创建不可变 worker 文件。evidence_id 必须是所需内容记录（工具结果 content_evidence_id），而非工具结果信封 ID；传信封会写入信封 JSON 而非目标字节。要执行的程序设置 executable=true。

finding_file.source: File a suspected or reproduced finding with evidence. Verified impact requires a separate immutable verifier record. severity critical/high requires a reproduced-or-better stage.
finding_file.text: 提交有证据的疑似或已复现发现。验证影响需要独立不可变 verifier 记录；critical/high 要求 reproduced 或更高阶段。

finding_get.source: Read a finding and its independent verification record.
finding_get.text: 读取发现及其独立验证记录。

finding_update.source: Update an existing finding. Impact promotion is enforced using independent execution evidence.
finding_update.text: 更新已有发现；提升影响必须有独立执行证据。

findings_list.source: List this assessment's findings and recorded stages.
findings_list.text: 列出本分析的发现及记录阶段。

finish_scan.source: Root only: finish the assessment after children and coverage are resolved.
finish_scan.text: 仅 root：子任务和覆盖项处理完毕后结束分析。

follow_up_agent.source: Explicitly assign a follow-up; reopens completed work in a new generation while preserving history. Use recipient_generation to guard against stale assignments.
follow_up_agent.text: 显式追加工作，以新 generation 重开已完成任务并保留历史；用 recipient_generation 拒绝过时代次的派单。

function_decompile.source: Ghidra: decompile a function by MODULE-RELATIVE offset.
function_decompile.text: Ghidra：按模块相对偏移反编译函数。

function_instructions.source: Ghidra: paginated function instructions and control-flow edges, including calls. Addresses are module-relative and bound to target SHA256. Optional target_evidence_id selects an in-run baseline binary.
function_instructions.text: Ghidra：分页函数指令及包含调用的控制流边；地址为模块相对且绑定目标 SHA256。可选 target_evidence_id 选择同 run 的基线二进制。

fuzz_start.source: Start AFL++ QEMU fuzzing after staging target and nonempty seed files.
fuzz_start.text: 暂存目标和非空种子后启动 AFL++ QEMU fuzz。

fuzz_status.source: Observe a bound AFL++ job and its real statistics/crash files.
fuzz_status.text: 观察已绑定 AFL++ job 的真实统计和崩溃文件。

input_minimize.source: Minimize a crashing input with fresh module-hash, PC-offset and frame signatures; requires GDB. allow_signal_only explicitly permits weaker signal-only equivalence. Poll job_status and collect job_artifacts.
input_minimize.text: 用新观察的模块哈希、PC 偏移及栈帧签名缩减崩溃输入，要求 GDB。allow_signal_only 显式允许较弱信号等价；轮询 job_status 并收集 job_artifacts。

interactive_close.source: Close your interactive session and terminate its process tree; also permits cleanup when its in-run owner is terminal.
interactive_close.text: 关闭所属交互会话及进程树，也可清理同 run 中 owner 已终止的会话。

interactive_send.source: Write bytes to an owned interactive session's stdin and return its newly produced output. The session stays alive between calls.
interactive_send.text: 向所属交互会话 stdin 写字节并返回新增输出；两次调用间会话保持存活。

interactive_start.source: Start a persistent interactive process (REPL-style program) owned by this agent; returns a session_id. Worker paths resolve as direct argv entries.
interactive_start.text: 启动本 Agent 所属的持久化交互进程（REPL），返回 session_id；worker 路径只在直接 argv 项解析。

job_artifacts.source: List and import original artifacts produced by an in-run job.
job_artifacts.text: 列出并导入同 run job 的原始产物。

job_cancel.source: Request cancellation of an owned in-run job.
job_cancel.text: 请求取消所属的同 run job。

job_start.source: Start a persistent process job in the configured worker; returns a job_id immediately. argv entries may use {target} as a placeholder for the staged target path (resolved by the harness and staged in isolated jobs); worker paths like files/... resolve only as direct argv entries, never inside shell strings. Jobs may read WUKONG_STATE_DIR and WUKONG_JOB_DIR from the environment.
job_start.text: 在配置 worker 启动持久进程，立即返回 job_id。argv 可用 {target} 占位，harness 解析并在隔离 job 暂存；files/... 只在直接 argv 项解析，不在 shell 字符串中解析。job 可读取 WUKONG_STATE_DIR、WUKONG_JOB_DIR。

job_status.source: Observe an in-run job, refresh persisted status and import raw observations.
job_status.text: 观察同 run job，刷新持久状态并导入原始观察。

libc_identify.source: Compare same-process symbol leaks against up to 16 supplied in-run ELF libc candidates, or only the worker's libc when omitted. Preserve candidate hashes, Build IDs, architecture, inconsistent leaks and ambiguous matches. Candidates never confirm the mapped runtime; no match describes only the searched corpus.
libc_identify.text: 使用同进程符号泄漏比较最多 16 份同 run ELF libc 候选；省略时只检查 worker libc。保留哈希、Build ID、架构、不一致泄漏和歧义。候选不确认映射身份，无匹配仅描述搜索集合。

load_skill.source: Activate a named capability or method (built-in or configured custom skill). Role instructions root/analyst/verifier are automatic and cannot be loaded here. Initial and active capabilities share a limit of 5 distinct names. Exact content/hash is persisted for the next fresh model boundary; replaces an initial copy of the same skill and survives compaction/resume. Loading never changes role, permissions or task completion criteria.
load_skill.text: 激活内置或自定义能力/方法。root/analyst/verifier 角色指令自动安装，不能在此加载。初始与动态能力合计最多五个名称。精确正文/哈希持久化，下一新模型边界生效，替代同名初始正文并跨压缩/恢复保留。加载不改变角色、权限或完成条件。

message_status.source: Inspect a sent/received message, its delivery state and correlated reply.
message_status.text: 查看收发消息、投递状态和关联回复。

mitigation_profile.source: Separate binary declarations, worker environment support and owned process/thread protection observations; optional address checks the actual containing mapping.
mitigation_profile.text: 区分二进制声明、worker 支持和所属进程/线程的保护观察；可选 address 检查其真实映射。

note_save.source: Save a shared note linked to this task.
note_save.text: 保存关联本任务的共享笔记。

notes_list.source: List shared notes for this assessment.

poc_verify.source: Independently replay a finding in fresh trial directories. Use argv/stdin delivery, or a bounded declarative network plan with the host-prepared launch_spec. Network trials use fresh TCP connections, capture/patch ASLR-dependent values and hash raw transcripts; server state is not reset and deployed runtime identity remains unconfirmed. Worker observations determine success.
poc_verify.text: 在新试验目录独立重放发现，使用 argv/stdin 或宿主准备 launch_spec 的有界网络计划。网络每次新 TCP 连接，捕获/修补 ASLR 值并哈希原始 transcript；不重置服务，部署身份仍未确认。成功以 worker 观察为准。

py_run.source: Run a Python script in the worker in ONE step: pass the source text directly (no base64, no file_put). The worker syntax-checks it and returns the compiler error inline before spending a job; then runs it as a background job (job_status for stdout/stderr). Optional argv entries arrive as sys.argv[1..]; an optional target=<staged path> is appended LAST to argv and staged automatically in isolated jobs — read it from sys.argv[-1]. Prefer this over file_put+job_start for any script longer than one line.
py_run.text: 一步在 worker 运行 Python 源文，无需 base64/file_put。先语法检查并直接返回编译错误，再创建后台 job（job_status 读输出）。可选 argv 对应 sys.argv[1..]；可选 target 暂存路径附加为最后参数，在隔离 job 自动暂存，用 sys.argv[-1] 读取。多行脚本优先于 file_put+job_start。

runtime_doctor.source: Inspect the configured worker's real platform, versions and available capabilities.
runtime_doctor.text: 检查已配置 worker 的真实平台、版本及能力。

runtime_prepare.source: Create an immutable execution copy of supplied target, libc and loader and return direct launch argv. Requires all three ELF files with matching architecture. Does not execute or modify originals; verify actual mappings separately.
runtime_prepare.text: 为提供的 target/libc/loader 创建不可变执行副本并返回直接 argv。三份 ELF 架构须一致。不执行或修改原件；真实映射另行确认。

runtime_profile.source: Inspect SHA256, ELF Build ID and architecture of in-run target/libc/loader files. Optionally observe actual mappings of an owned live debugger session. File candidates never imply a confirmed mapped runtime.
runtime_profile.text: 检查同 run target/libc/loader 的 SHA256、ELF Build ID 和架构；可选观察所属存活调试会话真实映射。文件候选不代表确认运行时。

seccomp_analyze.source: Decode an in-run raw classic-BPF seccomp filter into instructions, branch targets and actions; optionally evaluate concrete architecture/syscall/argument/IP probes. An artifact is not a confirmed installed policy, and probes are not an exhaustive allowlist.
seccomp_analyze.text: 解析同 run 原始 classic-BPF seccomp 产物的指令、分支和动作；可具体探测架构/syscall/参数/IP。产物不证明已安装策略，探测不等于完整 allowlist。

send_message_to_agent.source: Queue information, a question, reply, result or blocked notice. Information does not interrupt waits. Only follow_up_agent reopens completed work. Queued/included is not proof of processing.
send_message_to_agent.text: 入队 information、question、reply、result 或 blocked 通知。information 不打断等待，只有 follow_up_agent 重开已完成任务；queued/included 不证明已处理。

stage_target.source: Copy the run's SHA256-verified original target into the worker's immutable files area.
stage_target.text: 将 SHA256 已核对的本 run 原始目标复制到 worker 不可变文件区。

stop_agent.source: Stop yourself or your descendants, with a recorded reason.
stop_agent.text: 停止自己或后代并记录原因。

think.source: Record a concise audited scratch note for this agent. The original content remains in tool-call history and may be inherited by children; this is neither a private channel nor a context-saving mechanism. Use note_save for shared conclusions.
think.text: 记录本 Agent 的简短可审计草稿。原文留在工具历史并可能由子任务继承；不是私密通道或节省上下文的机制。共享结论使用 note_save。

threat_model_amend.source: Append a durable amendment to a shared threat model.
threat_model_amend.text: 向共享威胁模型追加持久修订。

threat_model_get.source: Read the shared threat model documents.
threat_model_get.text: 读取共享威胁模型文档。

threat_model_save.source: Create a shared threat model with a stable document ID.
threat_model_save.text: 创建稳定文档 ID 的共享威胁模型。

todo_save.source: Create a shared to-do item; status defaults to pending.
todo_save.text: 创建共享待办，默认 pending。

todo_update.source: Update the body or status of an existing shared to-do.
todo_update.text: 更新共享待办正文或状态。

verification_record.source: Verifier only: ingest a completed poc_verify job, its raw evidence and real trial counts. A crash verifies only crash behavior.
verification_record.text: 仅 verifier：导入完成的 poc_verify job、原始证据和真实尝试计数。崩溃只验证崩溃行为。

view_agent_graph.source: List this assessment's agent tree, scopes, states and results.
view_agent_graph.text: 列出本分析 Agent 树、scope、状态及结果。

wait_for_agents.source: Park on selected agents with policy all_terminal (default), all_success or any_success; return a satisfied/blocked outcome or timeout. Empty list means children.
wait_for_agents.text: 按 all_terminal（默认）、all_success 或 any_success 等待选定 Agent，返回 satisfied/blocked 或超时；空列表表示子任务。

xrefs_query.source: Ghidra: references to/from a MODULE-RELATIVE offset.
xrefs_query.text: Ghidra：查询模块相对偏移的入向/出向引用。
